July 10, 1972
BOARD MEMBERS 
Noman M. Cole, Jr. Chairman Ray W. Edwards - Henry S. Holland III Mrs. Wayne Jackson Andrew W. McThenia, Jr. W. H. Singleton Robert W. Spessard
Mr. Robert S. Everton Director of Redevelopment Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority Richmond, Virginia
Re: Randolph Urban Renewal Area Va. R-58
Dear Mr. Everton:
The staff has been asked to comment on the subject redevelopment project in the City of Richmond. It is our understanding the City's policy of separating sanitary and storm sewers in redevelopment areas will be followed in this project. The staff is of the opinion that the redevelopment project .proposed will not create any additional water pollution problems if separate sanitary and storm sewers are provided to the fullest extent feasible.
If we may be of further assistance, please contact this office.
Very truly yours, .
S.S. Mic Pude
L. S. McBride Richmond Area Representative Pollution Abatement Division
